castile_too_dominant.finding: Castile has 110 development, only 1 more than Granada and 9 more than Catalonia. It is not obviously too dominant from static setup alone.

granada_too_strong_or_weak.finding: Granada has 109 development and good trade centers, but Muslim tech, Sunni state religion, eight Catholic provinces, and one explicit fort constrain it.

portugal_survival_with_al_gharb.finding: Portugal keeps 89 development, Lisboa/Porto trade centers, a Lisboa fort, and Castile friendship; observer runs should confirm.

al_gharb_viability.finding: Al-Gharb has 24 development, three provinces, a defensive fort, and limited claims. It is viable but not overpowered.

catalonia_aragon_split.finding: Catalonia at 101 development greatly exceeds Aragon at 36. This may be acceptable but should be observed because Aragon is the Aragonese staple.

leon_galicia_navarre_viability.finding: Leon is medium-small at 46 development; Galicia at 28 and Navarre at 13 are fragile. Tune only after observer evidence.

known_limits: No EU4 launch or visual in-game pass was performed during this Phase 2B audit.
No observer run was performed; balance conclusions are static-data findings only.
Spanish, Aragonese, Portuguese, and Granadan mission assumptions remain a known later-content risk from the existing POC log.
recommended_next_steps: Run at least one Iberia-focused observer game to 1550 and one to 1650.
Track whether Iberia consolidates to 2-4 states by about 1550.
Track whether Spain forms in most runs by about 1650 while Portugal usually remains outside Spain.
Review mission-tree assumptions only after the static POC setup has observer evidence.
